candidate_generalization.normalization: one fold-global direction, midpoint, and scale pooled over shadow scores from training-fold candidates only
candidate_generalization.protocol: candidate-fold cross-fitting: all score directions, scales, feature combinations, and feature choices exclude the evaluated candidate

feature_selection: highest shadow-split AUROC, chosen without any held-out label

fit_free_fixed_score.protocol: predefined negative residual-energy score; no fitted direction, location, scale, layer combination, regularization, or feature selection

reference_utility.protocol: teacher-forced mean token log probability on public held-out references

threat_model: public base, released llm-compressor W4 artifact, one held-out artifact
